name: 9382-highrate-qwen306b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B -- ungated, ~1.5 GB of bf16 weights in one safetensors shard, already in this machine's HF cache; nothing downloads.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, allocated exclusively.
parallelism: TP=1, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one GPU, one server process, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 28 layers, hidden 1024, 16 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, intermediate 3072, vocab 151936 tied, rope_theta 1e6, 40960 max positions, bfloat16.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 400 requests/second, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 24000 requests (60 s of offered load) with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, over `/v1/completions`: ~500 prompt tokens (stdev 16, clamped 450-550) and exactly 8 generated tokens, streaming, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` in `extras.body`.
purpose: A compact Qwen autocomplete service streaming eight-token suggestions from 500-token prompts at 400 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments at the commit named by `commit_id:` in setupcard.md
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.5.2-46-geca59f96c3a). Anything not listed here is left at that
# commit's stock default.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
tp-size: 1

# The synthetic prompts share leading structure, so a prefix cache would hit on a variable number
# of leading tokens and put a different amount of work through prefill from run to run.
disable-radix-cache: true
